audio.t: Hi, Daniel. Did the Whitfield Manufacturing contract come back from the client?
Not yet. They said they'd return it by Tuesday, but their legal department is still reviewing the termination clause.
That's a problem. The agreement has to be filed with the court by Friday.
I know. I'll call their general counsel this afternoon and ask for a faster response.
Good. In the meantime, I can prepare the filing documents so they're ready to go.
Great idea. Also, could you reserve the small conference room for Thursday? I'd like to meet with the client if needed.
Sure. I'll book it right now.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: A contract that has not been returned
questions.explain: Họ bàn về hợp đồng Whitfield chưa được khách hàng gửi lại ('Did the ... contract come back from the client?' - 'Not yet').

questions.q: What is causing the delay?
options: The client is out of town
A legal review is still underway
questions.explain: Người đàn ông nói bộ phận pháp chế của khách vẫn đang xem xét điều khoản chấm dứt ('their legal department is still reviewing the termination clause').

questions.q: What will the woman do next?
options: File a document with the court
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ nói 'I'll book it right now' sau khi được nhờ đặt phòng họp nhỏ. Việc gọi cho tổng cố vấn là của người đàn ông.

audio.t: Good morning, everyone. We need to talk about the year-end audit schedule.
I just heard the auditors are arriving a week early. Is that right?
Yes, they'll be here starting the third of March instead of the tenth.
That's going to be tight. We still haven't reconciled the vendor accounts for the last quarter.
I can help with that. I finished the payroll reports yesterday, so I have some free time.
Thanks, Raj. Then Ken, you'll focus on the expense reports, and I'll prepare the tax schedules.
OK. But I'll need access to the shared drive. My login still isn't working.
I'll send a request to the IT department right after this meeting.

questions.q: What is the meeting mainly about?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ mở đầu về lịch kiểm toán cuối năm và nói kiểm toán viên đến sớm một tuần ('starting the third of March instead of the tenth').

questions.q: What does Ken say has not been finished?
questions.explain: Ken (M2) nói 'We still haven't reconciled the vendor accounts'. Báo cáo lương đã được Raj làm xong.

questions.q: What will the woman do after the meeting?
questions.explain: Cuối cuộc họp cô nói 'I'll send a request to the IT department right after this meeting' để xử lý lỗi đăng nhập của Ken.

audio.t: Maria, the city inspector is coming to the Riverside office tower tomorrow at ten.
Already? I thought the electrical work wouldn't be ready until next week.
It's been moved up because another site canceled their slot.
Well, the wiring on floors one through five is done, but floors six and seven still need work.
Then let's show him the completed floors only. I'll ask the electricians to work late tonight to finish the panel on six.
OK. I'll print the safety certificates and put them in the site office.
Perfect. And please remind everyone to wear their helmets when he walks through.

questions.q: Why is the inspection happening earlier than expected?
options: A permit is about to expire
questions.explain: Người đàn ông giải thích 'because another site canceled their slot' - lịch của công trường khác bị hủy nên lịch được dời lên.

questions.q: What does the man say he will do?
options: Ask the electricians to work late
questions.explain: Ông nói 'I'll ask the electricians to work late tonight'. In chứng nhận an toàn là việc của người phụ nữ.

questions.q: What will the woman put in the site office?
questions.explain: Cô nói 'I'll print the safety certificates and put them in the site office'.

audio.t: Facilities office, this is Priya.
Hi, Priya, it's Tom from the fourth floor. The air conditioning in our office has been blowing warm air since yesterday.
I'm sorry about that. A technician looked at the rooftop unit on Monday, but the part he needed hasn't arrived.
Do you know when it'll come? We have clients visiting on Thursday.
The supplier said Wednesday morning. Meanwhile, I can send you a couple of portable fans.
That would help. Could you also put a note on the door? We might keep it open for airflow.
Of course. I'll bring them up within the hour.

questions.q: Why is the man calling?
options: To ask about a parking pass
questions.explain: Ông báo điều hòa văn phòng thổi gió ấm từ hôm qua ('blowing warm air since yesterday').

questions.q: What is causing the delay in the repair?
options: A replacement part has not arrived
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ nói kỹ thuật viên cần một bộ phận mà 'the part he needed hasn't arrived'.

questions.q: What will the woman bring to the man's office?
questions.explain: Cô đề nghị 'I can send you a couple of portable fans' và nói sẽ mang lên trong vòng một giờ.

audio.t: Carlos, the shipment from the Osaka supplier was supposed to arrive this morning. Has it been scanned in?
Not yet. I just checked with the dock, and the container is still at the port.
I got an e-mail about that. Customs wants to inspect some of the packaging.
That's a problem. We promised delivery to our retail customers by Friday.
What if we ship the items we have in stock first, and send the rest later?
That could work, but it means two separate deliveries and extra shipping costs.
I'd rather do that than miss the deadline. Carlos, please prepare the partial orders. Nina, call the customers and explain.
Will do.

questions.q: What problem are the speakers discussing?
options: A shipment is held up at customs
questions.explain: Container vẫn ở cảng và 'Customs wants to inspect some of the packaging' nên hàng bị giữ ở hải quan.

questions.q: What does Carlos suggest?
options: Sending part of the order first
questions.explain: Carlos (người đàn ông) đề xuất 'ship the items we have in stock first, and send the rest later' - giao hàng từng phần.

questions.q: What will Nina do?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ giao 'Nina, call the customers and explain' và Nina (W2) đáp 'Will do'.

audio.t: Hi, Elena. I'm looking at the delivery routes for next week, and three of our drivers are scheduled for overtime.
Yes, that's because the holiday orders are starting to come in. We expect volume to rise by about thirty percent.
Should we hire temporary drivers?
I've already contacted an agency. They can send four people, but they'd need to complete the safety training first.
How long does the training take?
Two days. I've scheduled it for next Monday and Tuesday at the main depot.
Good. I'll update the route plan once they're certified.

questions.q: Why will the company need more drivers?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ giải thích 'the holiday orders are starting to come in' và khối lượng tăng khoảng 30%.

questions.q: What has the woman already done?
questions.explain: Cô nói 'I've already contacted an agency'. Việc cập nhật tuyến đường là của người đàn ông, sau khi tài xế được cấp chứng nhận.

questions.q: What will happen on Monday and Tuesday?
options: A warehouse inspection will be held
questions.explain: Cô nói đào tạo an toàn kéo dài hai ngày, lên lịch vào 'next Monday and Tuesday at the main depot'.

audio.t: Welcome to Brightpath Training Institute. How can I help you?
Hi, I'm interested in the data analysis certificate course. Is there still space in the evening session?
Let me check. The evening class that starts April 8 has two seats left. It meets Tuesdays and Thursdays from six to eight.
That works. What's the tuition?
It's eight hundred dollars, but if you register by the end of this week, you get a ten percent discount.
Great. Can I pay in two installments?
Yes, half now and half on the first day of class. I'll print the registration form for you.

questions.q: Where is the conversation taking place?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ chào 'Welcome to Brightpath Training Institute' và hai bên bàn về khóa học chứng chỉ, học phí, đăng ký.

questions.q: What does the woman say about the evening class?
questions.explain: Cô nói lớp tối 'has two seats left' (còn hai chỗ). Lớp học vào thứ Ba và thứ Năm, không phải cuối tuần.

questions.q: What will the woman do next?
questions.explain: Câu cuối của cô: 'I'll print the registration form for you'.

audio.t: Hi, Grace. How's the planning for the leadership seminar going?
Mostly good, but our keynote speaker just told me he can't fly in until the morning of the event.
That's cutting it close. What if his flight is delayed?
I've thought about that. I'm arranging for Dr. Patel, who's already attending, to give a short talk as a backup.
Smart. By the way, did we confirm the number of lunches with the caterer?
Not yet. Registration closes tomorrow, so I'll send them the final count then.
OK. I'll prepare the name badges once I get the attendee list.

questions.q: What problem does the woman mention?
questions.explain: Cô nói diễn giả chính 'can't fly in until the morning of the event' - giờ đến quá sát giờ sự kiện.

questions.q: What has the woman arranged?
questions.explain: Cô sắp xếp để Dr. Patel 'give a short talk as a backup' phòng khi diễn giả chính đến trễ.

questions.q: What will the man do after he gets the attendee list?
questions.explain: Ông nói 'I'll prepare the name badges once I get the attendee list'. Gửi số lượng bữa trưa là việc của người phụ nữ.

audio.t: Thanks for coming in. As you know, we're catering the company anniversary dinner for two hundred guests.
Yes, and I wanted to go over the menu. Our clients asked for at least two vegetarian options.
We can do a mushroom risotto and a roasted vegetable tart. Both are popular.
Perfect. The other concern is timing. Dinner is at seven, so we'll need to start setting up by two.
That's fine, but we'll need access to the kitchen on the second floor to keep the food warm.
I'll ask the building manager to unlock it, and I'll let you know by tomorrow.
Great. Once that's confirmed, I'll send over the deposit.

questions.q: What event are the speakers planning for?
questions.explain: Người đàn ông nói họ phục vụ 'the company anniversary dinner for two hundred guests'.

questions.q: What did the clients request?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ đầu tiên nói khách hàng 'asked for at least two vegetarian options'.

questions.q: What will the first woman ask the building manager to do?
questions.explain: Cô nói 'I'll ask the building manager to unlock it' - 'it' là căn bếp ở tầng hai.

audio.t: Welcome to Peak Fitness. Are you here for a tour?
Yes, I signed up for the trial week online. My name is Jordan Reyes.
Great, Mr. Reyes. Let me show you around. Our weight room is on the right, and the group classes are held on the second floor.
Do I need to book the classes in advance?
For the popular ones like cycling and yoga, yes. You can reserve a spot through our mobile app.
I don't have the app yet.
No problem. I'll help you download it, and then I'll give you a free guest pass for a friend.

questions.q: Who most likely is the man?
questions.explain: Ông nói 'I signed up for the trial week online' - ông là thành viên dùng thử.

questions.q: How can the man reserve a class?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ nói 'You can reserve a spot through our mobile app'.

questions.q: What will the woman give the man?
questions.explain: Cô nói 'I'll give you a free guest pass for a friend'.

audio.t: Sofia, the beta version of our scheduling app is ready for testing. Do you have a minute?
Sure. Is it the one the Lisbon clinic requested?
That's right. They want to use it to manage patient appointments, but they've asked for a feature that sends reminders by text message.
That shouldn't be too hard. Have we budgeted for a messaging service?
Not yet. A provider quoted us about two hundred dollars a month.
Let's bring it up at tomorrow's budget meeting. In the meantime, I'll start writing the specifications.

questions.q: What kind of product are the speakers discussing?
questions.explain: Họ nói về 'the beta version of our scheduling app' dùng để quản lý lịch hẹn bệnh nhân.

questions.q: What did the clinic ask for?
questions.explain: Người đàn ông nói phòng khám 'asked for a feature that sends reminders by text message'.

questions.q: What will be discussed at tomorrow's meeting?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ đề nghị 'bring it up at tomorrow's budget meeting' - vấn đề ngân sách cho dịch vụ nhắn tin.

audio.t: Good afternoon, Mr. Nakamura. Thank you for coming in. This is my colleague, Mr. Bell.
Thanks, Ms. Ortiz. I'm here about the lease dispute with my landlord.
Yes, we've read your documents. It seems he raised the rent without giving you the sixty days' notice required by your agreement.
Exactly. I've been paying the higher amount for three months.
We'd recommend sending a formal letter first. If he doesn't respond, we can file a claim.
How much would the letter cost?
Our fee for that is a flat three hundred dollars. I can have it drafted by Friday.
That sounds reasonable. Please go ahead.

questions.q: What problem does the man describe?
options: His landlord raised the rent without proper notice
questions.explain: Mr. Bell nêu rõ chủ nhà tăng tiền thuê mà không báo trước 60 ngày, và Mr. Nakamura xác nhận 'Exactly'.

questions.q: What do the lawyers recommend?
questions.explain: Ms. Ortiz nói 'We'd recommend sending a formal letter first'. Nộp đơn kiện chỉ là bước sau nếu chủ nhà không phản hồi.

questions.q: What does Mr. Bell say he will do by Friday?
questions.explain: Mr. Bell (M2) nói 'I can have it drafted by Friday' - 'it' là bức thư chính thức.

audio.t: Hello, this is Greg Mason. I'm calling about the invoice I received from your accounting firm.
Hi, Mr. Mason. This is Helen from billing. How can I help?
The invoice lists ten hours of consulting, but I believe we agreed on eight.
Let me check the time records. Hmm, it looks like two hours were added for a meeting on the twelfth.
That meeting was canceled. Nobody attended.
I see. That's our mistake. I'll correct the invoice and e-mail you a new one by the end of today.
Thanks. And could you also send me the receipt for last month's payment? I need it for my tax records.
Certainly. I'll attach it to the same message.

questions.q: Why is the man calling?
questions.explain: Ông gọi về hóa đơn ('calling about the invoice') vì số giờ tư vấn ghi nhiều hơn thỏa thuận.

questions.q: According to the woman, what caused the error?
questions.explain: Hai giờ được thêm cho cuộc họp ngày 12, nhưng cuộc họp đã bị hủy; cô thừa nhận 'That's our mistake'.

questions.q: What will the woman send to the man?
options: A corrected invoice and a receipt
questions.explain: Cô sẽ gửi hóa đơn đã sửa và đính kèm biên lai thanh toán tháng trước trong cùng một e-mail.
